 Election Day 2026: Elon Votes! to provide transportation to polling places, host watch event
 By Andrew Moffa , staff
 October 26, 2026 
 Voting Booths set up in rows on Election Day 
 Members of the Elon community are invited to utilize the Election Day shuttle throughout the day and gather in the Moseley Center First Floor to watch coverage of the 2026 midterm elections.

 Tuesday, Nov. 3 is Election Day, and Elon Votes! is providing opportunities to engage in the democratic process. Students who are already registered to vote in Alamance County are invited to utilize the Election Day shuttle throughout the day. A shuttle will run from the Center for the Arts to two local polling places from 8 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 To find out the location of your polling place on Election Day in Alamance County, simply go to the North Carolina Board of Elections Polling Place Search website and confirm your polling place before you leave to vote. Note that the Elon campus is divided into two precincts, so this is especially important.
 Later that evening, the Elon community is invited to come together and watch Election results come in from across the country during a watch event on the First Floor of the Moseley Center from 8 to 11 p.m.
 For additional information about voting and Election Day resources, please visit the Elon Votes! Website.
